-- R-140 每日對帳(連外部清算庫)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_r140 AS
SELECT t.account_id, t.amount
FROM transactions t
WHERE t.tx_time >= :start_date AND t.tx_time < :end_date
  AND t.conn_string = 'host=10.0.0.9 user=demo password=NotARealSecret123 dbname=settle';
